quests.title: Climb one step
quests.ask: Fill in `climb_step()`: from the foot of a step, facing east, it should leave the robot standing on top of it, facing east again.
quests.nudge: Where it ends is where the next step starts. Which way should it face for the next one?

quests.title: Two steps in a row
quests.ask: Use `climb_step()` on the real stairs so the robot gets up to the marked cell on the second step.
quests.nudge: If the second climb goes wrong, look at where the first one leaves the robot.

quests.title: Up to the gem
quests.ask: Carry on to the top of the staircase and pick up the gem waiting there.
quests.nudge: Count the steps in the picture, not in your head.
